title: 第005章 全明星联赛第006章 他能给自己提鞋
lines: 时间一晃五天后，苏恒持续沉迷学习，还再次接到了一个任务，依旧是让他在战场上血虐学霸，任务奖励，随机一门学术学说提升1级，失败惩罚依旧是随机降低一门学术术法1个等级。
但这次他没有找到合适的目标，不是每次都有张宏那样的家伙跳出来，送给他打脸被虐的。
苏恒坐在宿舍里琢磨，该怎么才能找到战场，完成任务，就听到不远处正玩手机的罗绍飞一脸激动，“我擦，老苏，大学生全明星联赛开始报名了，快，快来给我一起刷论坛，咱们要好好为女神小姐姐摇旗呐喊。”
“大三的学霸林苒苒，那是我梦中女神。我要不要带一个啦啦队，在校内竞赛时给她去助威？”
苏恒楞了一下，才拍着大腿在心下低骂，大学生全明星联赛，他怎么忘了这茬？这可是全大明，不对，是全地球最著名的盛会之一。
放在上辈子的地球，华夏内大学生赛事？别逗，全球最火热的是足球世界杯，奥运等赛事。
这个地球，大明帝国的大学生全明星联赛，才是全球瞩目，最昌盛的盛会，比上辈子世界杯和奥运都火爆太多倍了。
这是所有大学生狂欢的时间段。
千万不要以为这是普通的赛事。
简单来说，目前整个大明帝国许许多多的政要、富豪、大学士等等，基本都是这国民大赛出身。
就说体术系那些迎男而上的肌肉男们，搏杀起来拳拳到肉、实力越强、厮杀能力越狠，你就是一个超级合格的强者，战士。
能在全大明大学生联赛，搏杀式武力型赛事里脱颖而出，成为一代至强，大学毕业后不管进哪个官方系统，还是私自发展，真正的强者都会受到尊重，无数人抢着给你最优待遇。你想进军方都没任何难度，还至少是千户级别军官起步。
在大明有家族有财阀有世家，但众多的一二本大学才是培养全大明二百多亿子民里天才、强者的最强造星工厂，大学你能拿到一届至强，不管武力赛还是其他科系竞赛，未来前途绝对无量，很多届的全明星联赛，搏杀能力最强者，都是20出头就是超凡境，个人飞天遁地、寿元200载的了。
灵化寿元大限100左右，超凡200、神通400、星主800年、灾变1600年。
能在20多岁或不到20岁就晋升超凡，不中途陨落，成就神通境有大希望，神通境，那是靠个体移山倒海，肉身抗科技侧导弹的存在！要知道大明境内，很多军方大佬、开封海外的总督、坐镇一方的诸侯，也只是超凡五六重或者神通境。
尤其是这些大佬们，很多也是在全明星联赛里崭露头角，后来才平步青云的。
只这一点，你就看出全明星大学生联赛，有多么恐怖的影响力。这不是上辈子足球或奥运能比的，站在全国赛场的，都是下一代的超级强者们，下一代大明帝国的社会栋梁，主导全球大势的超级精英！
每一个胜出者，或每个类别赛事前十，都是各行各业的真正明星。
当然，这是指全大明范围。
以苏恒的实力，区区灵化2重去参加武道侧厮杀战斗？他连报名的资格都没有，他是想去找辅导员报名灵木系的项目。
江州理工是一所二本高校。
大明有30多所一本院校，最牛的是皇家学院和清华、北大三座学府，这三座也是全地球前十的高校！
江州理工在全国排名八十开外，不同学校重点专业的不同，实力也有着强大的层次差，每个系报名名额也有限。
苏恒知道的，全明星赛灵木系，江州理工有三个名额。
整个高校灵木系只有资格筛选出三个校队成员去参加省赛。
这名额，系内规则是让大四届提供4人，大三提供三人，大二提供两个，大一就只有一个名额！
汇集起来全系大一到大四、四届学生里最优秀的十人，再在校内全系同学面前，争夺三个校队名额。胜出后，才是灵木系江州理工代表队，去和全省三所一本高校、二十多所二本高校的校队竞争。
最终全省灵木系选出5人团队，代表江东省前往京城参加全国大赛。
足足二十年，二十年来江州理工灵木系，连拿到省队名额的经历都没有过，次次陪跑，更别谈什么入围国赛了。
就算这样，只要你代表学校出战，一下子会成为校内明星，若能在省赛表现的精彩一点？会成为省城明星，一旦入围国赛，你就是省级英雄。
奖励？不管校内奖励还是国赛的奖励，足以让一个富豪家庭心动，别提苏恒这平民出身的天才了，他若是能参赛，只要代表学校拿到国赛门票，对比上一世，比普通人中十亿大奖的奖励还丰厚。
参加全明星大学生联赛，是一个大学生最重要的资历，只要一次，哪怕是代表自己所属高校出战过，第一轮就被淘汰，毕业后也会被无数公司财团欢迎，想留校工作也是轻而易举。
平民出身没有足够社会资源人脉，全明星赛就是一条金光大道，这里只问实力不问出身，以前苏恒在大一全系50多名，哪有信心去和前面的学霸们竞争代表大一的唯一一个名额
得到超级学神系统，他才有把握试一试。
如果他能入围校队，那就是江州理工的新一届英雄，别忘了他是大一新生，还有三年可以申请加入校队，参加后面三届的全明星联赛，若能在大一就成为校队的人，绝对是全系的宝贝。
系领导会被他倍加呵护。
之前把苏恒父亲殴打致残，至今还是植物人状态的许家，在苏恒老家县城那么猖狂，为什么不敢杀苏恒？因为他是江州理工高材生，随意杀掉这样的进化学院高校生，许家也要承担后果的。
上次的杜欢，明明有着秒杀苏恒的实力，恐怕那位都是武道型灵化四五重的强者，也只打出一拳让苏恒吃点苦头，真正伤势都没留下。
一个名校生的招牌，还是有不小作用的。
就像上个地球你若是清华北大生，得罪了小地方强势人物，也不可能说一上来就对你打打杀杀，你当高校领导层是摆设？当以前的一届届知名校友是假的？江州理工虽是二本，但校长也是超凡六重巅峰！
如果苏恒能入围校队，不止自身安全有了极大保证，他父亲治病所需的灵植宝药，也会轻而易举解决。
思索到最后，苏恒起身就向外走去，直奔辅导员办公室。
content_en:
Five days later, Su Heng continued to indulge in learning, and received another task, which again asked him to brutally torture the top academics on the battlefield. The task reward was to increase a random academic doctrine by 1 level, and the penalty for failure was still to randomly lower an academic spell by 1 level.
But this time he didn't find a suitable target. It's not every time that a guy like Zhang Hong jumps out and gives him a slap in the face.
Su Heng was sitting in the dormitory thinking about how to find the battlefield and complete the task. He heard Luo Shaofei who was playing with his mobile phone not far away and said excitedly, "Hey, Lao Su, the registration for the College All-Star League has started. Come and check the forum with me. Let's cheer for the goddess."
"Lin Ranran, the top student in junior year, is the goddess of my dreams. Do I want to bring a cheerleading team to cheer her up during school competitions?"
Su Heng was stunned for a moment, then slapped his thigh and cursed in his mind, "College All-Star League, how could he forget about this?" This is the entire Ming Dynasty, no, it is one of the most famous events on the planet.
On Earth in a previous life, what was the competition among college students in China? Don’t be ridiculous, the most popular events in the world are the Football World Cup, the Olympics and other events.
On this earth, the Ming Empire's College All-Star League is the most prosperous event that attracts global attention. It is many times more popular than the World Cup and the Olympics in the previous life.
This is the time when all college students party.
Don’t think this is an ordinary event.
To put it simply, many politicians, rich men, bachelors, etc. in the entire Ming Empire are basically from this national competition.
Let’s just talk about those muscular men in the Taijutsu department who come up to men. If you fight with fists and fists, the stronger you are and the more ruthless your fighting ability is, you are a super qualified strong man and warrior.
If you can stand out in the Ming Dynasty University Student League, a fighting-style force-based competition, and become the strongest of the generation, no matter which official system you join after graduation, or you develop privately, the real strong will be respected, and countless people will rush to give you the best treatment. It's not difficult for you to join the military, and you should at least start as a Qianhu level officer.
There are families, plutocrats, and aristocratic families in the Ming Dynasty, but the numerous one- and two-level universities are the most powerful star-making factories for cultivating geniuses and strong men among the more than 20 billion people of the Ming Dynasty. If you can get the strongest one in the university, no matter the martial arts competition or other department competitions, your future is absolutely boundless. In many all-star leagues, those with the strongest fighting ability will reach the transcendent realm in their early 20s, fly to the sky and escape from the earth, and live for 200 years.
The lifespan of spiritual transformation is about 100 years, extraordinary 200 years, supernatural power 400 years, star master 800 years, and catastrophic life 1600 years.
Those who can be promoted to extraordinary in their 20s or under 20 years old, without falling midway, have great hope of achieving the magical power state. The magical power state relies on individuals to move mountains and seas, and the physical body can resist the existence of technological side missiles! You must know that within the Ming Dynasty, many military bosses, overseas governors of Kaifeng, and princes sitting on one side are only at the fifth or sixth level of transcendence or supernatural power level.
Especially these big guys, many of them made their mark in the All-Star League and then rose to prominence.
From this alone, you can see how terrifying the All-Star College League is. This is not comparable to football or the Olympics in the previous life. Those standing in the national arena are the next generation of super strong people, the next generation of social pillars of the Ming Empire, and the super elites who dominate the global trend!
Every winner, or the top ten in each category, is a true star in their own profession.
Of course, this refers to the entire Ming Dynasty.
With Su Heng's strength, how could he participate in a side-to-side martial arts battle at the second level of Linghua? He didn't even have the qualifications to sign up. He wanted to find a counselor to sign up for a spiritual tree-related project.
Jiangzhou University of Technology is a second-tier university.
There are more than 30 first-level universities in Ming Dynasty. The most powerful ones are the Royal College and the three universities of Tsinghua and Peking University. These three are also among the top ten universities in the world!
Jiangzhou University of Science and Technology ranks outside the 80th place in the country. Different schools have different key majors and strong differences in strength. The registration quota for each department is also limited.
Su Heng knew that Jiangzhou University of Science and Technology had three spots for the Lingmu team in the All-Star Game.
The Lingmu Department of the entire university is only qualified to select three school team members to participate in the provincial competition.
For this quota, the rules within the department are to allow four seniors, three juniors, two sophomores, and only one quota for freshmen!
The ten best students from the freshman to senior years in the entire department were gathered together to compete for three school team spots in front of all the classmates in the school. After winning, the Lingmu Department Jiangzhou University of Technology team will compete with the teams from three first-tier universities and more than twenty second-tier universities in the province.
In the end, a team of 5 people from the Lingmu Department of the province was selected to represent Jiangdong Province and go to Beijing to participate in the national competition.
For twenty years, the Lingmu Department of Jiangzhou University of Science and Technology has never even had the experience of getting a place on the provincial team.
Even so, as long as you represent the school, you will suddenly become a star in the school. What if you can perform better in the provincial competition? You will become a star in the provincial capital. Once you are shortlisted for the national competition, you will be a provincial hero.
award? Regardless of the rewards within the school or the national competition, they are enough to make a wealthy family excited. Not to mention Su Heng, a genius born as a commoner. If he can participate, as long as he represents the school and gets tickets to the national competition, compared to the previous life, the reward will be more generous than the billion-dollar award for ordinary people.
Participating in the All-Star College League is the most important qualification for a college student. Even if you represent your university once, you will be eliminated in the first round. After graduation, you will be welcomed by countless companies and consortiums, and it will be easy to stay in school and work.
People from civilian backgrounds do not have enough social resources and connections. The All-Star Game is a golden avenue. Here, only the ability is asked, not the background. In the past, Su Heng was among more than 50 people in the freshman department. How could he have the confidence to compete with the top academics in front of him for the only spot representing the freshman year?
Only after getting the Super God of Learning System did he have the confidence to give it a try.
If he can be shortlisted for the school team, he will be the new hero of Jiangzhou University of Technology. Don't forget that he is a freshman. He has three years left to apply to join the school team and participate in the next three All-Star Leagues. If he can become a member of the school team in his freshman year, he will definitely be the treasure of the entire department.
Department leaders will be doubly cared for by him.
The Xu family, which had previously beaten Su Heng's father to death and was still in a vegetative state, was so rampant in Su Heng's hometown county. Why didn't they dare to kill Su Heng? Because he was a top student at Jiangzhou University of Science and Technology, if he killed such a high school student from Evolution College at will, the Xu family would have to bear the consequences.
Last time, Du Huan clearly had the ability to kill Su Heng in an instant. I am afraid that the strong man who was at the fourth or fifth level of martial arts type spiritualization only punched Su Heng to suffer a little, leaving no real injuries.
The sign of being a student from a prestigious school still plays a big role.
Just like last time on Earth, if you were a student at Tsinghua University and Peking University, and you offended a powerful person in a small place, it would be impossible for you to be beaten and killed as soon as you came up. Are you just a showpiece for the university leadership? Are famous alumni from the past fake? Although Jiangzhou University of Science and Technology is a second-level university, its principal is also at the pinnacle of the sixth level of extraordinary!
If Su Heng can be shortlisted for the school team, not only will his own safety be greatly guaranteed, but the spiritual plant medicine his father needs to treat his illness will also be easily solved.
After thinking about it at the end, Su Heng stood up and walked out, heading straight to the counselor's office.
title_en: Chapter 005 All-Star League Chapter 006 He can carry his own shoes
